attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  StickyLips System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetJawBone: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetNotJawBone: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetLeftMouthCtrl: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetMouthEdge: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetFaceGeo: set the node/object name this block should use.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
